name: Universal TV Video Picture-in-Picture
description: Makes videos float in a corner so you can keep browsing while watching on TV

params.code: document.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(function(vid) { var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) { entries.forEach(function(entry) { if (!entry.isIntersecting && !vid.paused) { vid.style.cssText = 'position:fixed !important;bottom:20px;right:20px;width:360px;height:auto;z-index:99999;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);border:2px solid #30363d;'; } else { vid.style.cssText = ''; } }); }, { threshold: 0.3 }); observer.observe(vid); }); return 'pip-mode-active';
